# PR Insights Labeler

GitHub Action that auto-labels pull requests by size, complexity, category, and risk.

## Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview and quick start.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Development workflow, quality gates, and release conventions.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): Documentation index by audience (Users / Maintainers).

## Source

- [src/](src/): Action implementation.
- [__tests__/](__tests__/): Test suite.

## Docs

- [docs/en/configuration.md](docs/en/configuration.md): All configuration options and defaults.
- [docs/en/advanced-usage.md](docs/en/advanced-usage.md): Advanced workflows and customization.
- [docs/en/categories.md](docs/en/categories.md): Category label definitions.
- [docs/en/troubleshooting.md](docs/en/troubleshooting.md): Common issues and fixes.
- [docs/en/labeling-rules.md](docs/en/labeling-rules.md): Labeling rules quick reference.
- [docs/ja/API.md](docs/ja/API.md): Internal API specification (Japanese).
- [docs/ja/release-process.md](docs/ja/release-process.md): Release process (Japanese).

## Development Commands

- `pnpm lint`: Code style check.
- `pnpm type-check`: TypeScript type check.
- `pnpm test`: Run automated tests.
- `pnpm build`: Build the action bundle.
